name: blender-web-3d
title: Blender Web 3D
description: Drives Blender headless or via MCP to build, modify, render, and optimize 3D models, then publishes them as fast Three.js/Next.js web experiences with modern color, shader, and compression pipelines.
why: The only Blender-to-web pipeline in the collection: real 3D asset craft with optimization and deploy covered, plus a runnable demo to start from.
